issues.where: the red water across the foreground, midground, and right side
issues.what: the brine looks like a flat, matte pink-red procedural pattern with no sky reflections, ripples, or wet sheen
issues.fix: replace the matte surface with dark, glossy, reflective rust-red water with overcast sky speculars, surface ripples, and wet meniscus edges

issues.where: the heavy animals' legs, bellies, and where they enter the water
issues.what: the legs meet the torso along sharp, dark intersecting seams like separate cylinders, lack wet mud staining and hanging drips, and enter the water with no displacement or ripples
issues.fix: blend the legs smoothly into the torso with continuous skin folds, coat the lower bodies and legs in wet glistening rust-red mud with hanging drips, and add water displacement and ripples around each leg

issues.where: the depth of field, horizon, and background flats
issues.what: everything from foreground to far horizon is uniformly sharp with a hard horizon line and distant hills, losing the shallow telephoto focus and thick overcast mist of -a
issues.fix: apply shallow optical depth of field blurring the near foreground and distant flats, and thicken the overcast atmospheric fog to obscure the horizon

issues.where: the lighting, contrast, and mud banks across the frame
issues.what: the scene is flatly lit and chalky pink-grey, missing deep contact shadows under the animals, wet specular highlights, and chunky salt-crusted mud banks
issues.fix: deepen ambient occlusion and contact shadows beneath the animals, restore wet specular highlights, and break up the smooth ground into textured wet mud with granular white salt crusts

issues.where: the native-size crops of the main animal's hide and the water behind the smaller animal
issues.what: the hide is smooth low-contrast noise with sparse black spikes instead of deep wet leathery wrinkles, and the water is a flat unreflective pink-brown pattern
issues.fix: sculpt fine wet hide folds, mud crusts, and organic micro-relief on the skin, and give the water real liquid reflections and surface breakup

issues.where: the foreground mud, water channels, and midground pools
issues.what: the wet glistening mud ledges and deep reflective rust-red brine pools of -a are replaced by a smooth, matte, uniform grey-brown surface with no red brine or reflections
issues.fix: rebuild the foreground with crisp wet mud crusts, shallow channels of glossy dark-red brine, and bright overcast specular reflections across wet mud and water

issues.where: the foreground heavy animal's surface, tufts, and waterline
issues.what: the body has a harsh dark Voronoi crack pattern with stiff flat polygon hair strips and sits on the mud along a hard floating edge without ripples or wet mud contact
issues.fix: replace the Voronoi cracks and flat hair strips with organic wet wrinkled skin and mud caking, and sink the lower edge and tendrils into wet mud with meniscus and ripples

issues.where: the foreground salt mound and midground crusty mounds
issues.what: the foreground mound is covered in tiny uniform geometric spikes rather than granular salt, and the midground mounds look like blocky grey-white rocks with smooth cylinders protruding from them
issues.fix: replace the spiky needles and blocky rocks with irregular, crystalline white salt crusts and finely detailed mud-and-salt formations

issues.where: the camera focus and background atmosphere
issues.what: the foreground mound, background stalks, distant animals, and far hills are all in crisp focus with too little mist, flattening the depth of the shot
issues.fix: add strong shallow depth of field blurring both the near foreground mound and the background, and increase misty haze so the far horizon disappears

issues.where: both native-size crops of the tendrils, waterline, and mud surface
issues.what: the mud and water are blurry, featureless CG shading with low-poly bumps, rectangular brown hair cards hang off the animal, and the foreground mound shows sharp polygonal spikes
issues.fix: add high-frequency wet mud texture, specular water ripples around the submerged tendrils, clean organic hide edges without flat hair cards, and granular salt crystals on the foreground mound

issues.where: the foreground animal at bottom center and the red-tufted stalks
issues.what: the foreground animal is covered in coarse spiky fur tufts, the left foreground stalk is a bare straight cylinder, and distant stalks are sparse tiny sticks
issues.fix: replace the coarse fur tufts with wet mud-streaked hide and match the gnarled stalks and drooping dark-crimson frond clusters of -a

issues.where: the background stalks and background animals
issues.what: the stalks form a sharp, rigid wall of straight poles with spiky tufts, and the background animal on the right shows blocky hard-edged legs and flat shading
issues.fix: soften the background stalks with organic curves, drooping crimson fronds, and misty bokeh, and blend the distant animals softly into the fog and reflective red water
